residual_risks: Coverage here is unit-level only. The auth ordering and fail-closed behavior are exercised in workouts.service.spec.ts and workouts.controller.spec.ts, but there is still no integration-level proof around the real guard/request pipeline plus blob storage.
Blob parse/download failures still degrade to legacy route/lap data by design, so correctness still depends on the legacy compatibility path until the backfill/cleanup follow-up tasks land.
